name: bo7
title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 (BO7)
note: Phase 1 (container, working set, exe, primitives): the tables are not written yet. Exe: the decrypted cod.exe (PE timestamp 0x6aadce0e, the same as the install's), flattened (file offset == RVA). Install: Steam's Call of Duty HQ, cod25 folder (plain files, no CASC).
install_note: Plain Steam files: cod25\*.ff with their .fp update patches beside (Games/IW/Container25.cpp applies them), cod25\lpc\ the ffotd zones, streamed data in cod25\*.xsub. The working set: every zone not named *_tr, and 25 transient zones per name family.
args_note: every loader and primitive takes the load context in rcx: file_read(ctx, dst, n), Load_Stream(ctx, bool atStreamStart, dst, n), Load_String(ctx, char **), the context's push(ctx, block) and alloc(ctx, align)
rva_note: DB_ReadXFile(ctx, dst, n); LoadStreamTA(ctx, atStreamStart, dst, n): reads unless block 11 (memset), the position ctx+0x108 advanced; Load_String(ctx, char **) a byte at a time; alloc/push/pop are the context's methods (vtable 0xb404b58 +8/+0x10/+0x18; push and pop forward to the stream state at ctx+8)

stream.markers_note: draft: phase 2 settles the markers (a pointer & 0x7fffffffffffffff equal to 0x7fffffffffffffff inline, 0x3fffffffffffffff a name-only reference; the asset list's slots -1 or 0x7000000000000000)
stream.stream_objects_note: loadStreamObj (vtable slot 0xc8b4098, functor 0xc8b40a0): the readers' own read for atStreamStart, set by DB_InitLoadStreams to LoadStreamTA
stream.machinery_note: the function object assignment and the stream state init DB_InitLoadStreams (0x3ad6530) calls; Load_AssetType (the hash mapped in place) and Load_AssetHeader (the type switch: its je targets are the loaders, which the reach rule does not follow); the Load_Stream functor class (vtable 0xcb3a750: invoke, copy, move, destroy), what the function object calls
stream.load_stream_thunks_note: 0x382eeb0(&loadStreamObj, ctx, bool atStreamStart, dst, u64 n) calls the function object it is handed (one caller: weapontunables 0x38b93e8, its 0x5e68-byte struct). It names no stream object itself: the reach rule skipped it and the emulator read nothing there (mp_sat_ava_*_skr_entities went astray at the next xanim). Machinery, a stream entry, and a Load_Stream to the transcriber
stream.alloc_thunks_note: 0x382f470(ctx, size): `mov rax, [rcx]; dec rdx; jmp [rax + 8]`, the context's alloc with the alignment given as a size (weapontunables 0x38b94c0, 0x38b9d9c)
stream.null_page_note: engine lookups the dump leaves empty return null and the loader reads through it (MWIII AllocateUniqueString 0x3d41bd0 skipped; BO7 Load_CustomScriptString 0x3ad7730 falls back to address 8 when the script string map has no entry): a zero page reads as an empty result
stream.rewind_prepare_note: DB_RewindPrepare(ctx, R*, T** p, bool second, int mode, bool): v = *(p + 8 * second); bit 63: an 8-byte descriptor {size u24, skip size u24 at 24, align log2 u6 at 48} read by DB_ReadXFile unless mode 2, then the data; bit 60: the data; else a reference the rewind table resolves (0x38cc9d0), nothing read. R+0x28 the answer the caller tests. Under emulation (mp_sat_rift_entities, 11 178 calls) exactly that: 6 493 bit-60 loads, 4 681 references, 4 bit-63 reads of 8
stream.pointer_ifs_note: the C++ walker links each pointer of its IF chain: one DB_RewindPrepare decides by its top bits (bit 63 past the 8-byte descriptor, bit 60 here, else the rewind table's key, the low 60 bits, of an earlier load; ZoneTableWalker PointerIf kind 3), an asset slot inline (0x7fff...) or by the asset's 63-bit hash (kind 4)
stream.read_calls_note: Load_CustomScriptString(ctx, u32 *): the high u32 of the script string hash read by file_read into a local, the index looked up in the zone's map

load_state.note: DBLoadCtx (0xc40, its delete 0x3a658c0): the vtable at 0, the stream state at 8 (position +0x108, block +0x190)

stream_init_call.note: DB_InitLoadStreams(ctx, zone): the stream state over the zone memory's 16 blocks (0x3a71650), LoadStreamTA installed in loadStreamObj

memory_objects.note: DBLoadCtxRewind (acts handler_game_bo7.cpp): hashedRefs at 0x38, numBlocks 0x40; the rewind lookups (0x38cc9d0) divide by numBlocks and walk the bucket. DB_RegisterStreamOffset (0x382eef0) files {next, key, data} nodes it pops off the free list at 0x10 (empty, it files nothing). Kept across a chained load (emulator run_chain): the keys the zones before filed

the script string map Load_CustomScriptString (0x3ad7730) looks the zone's u64 string hashes up in (same bucket layout as the rewind table); empty, a lookup finds nothing and the slot reads 0 (stream.null_page)

chain_counters_note: per zone of a chained load: DB_RewindPrepare's reference lookup 0x38cc9d0 (al: the key is filed), a loaded pointer's data read (0x382f220) or skipped as already filed (0x382f39e, then DB_SkipXFile 0x3a52c20 over its skip size)

asset_type_map.note: GetMappedType: FNV-1a 32 of the type name -> pool id

asset_dispatch.note: Load_Asset(ctx, 0, &entry): Load_AssetType maps the hash (GetMappedType), Load_AssetHeader 0x38c5990 the cmp chain to the type's Ptr loader

zone_load.note: ParseFastFile 0x3ad6a60 (DB_LoadXFile 0x3a4fd80): file_read of the 0x30 list, push(15), DB_LoadStringList, DB_LoadUnkList (under the memmapped block 11: nothing in the file), pop, push(15), the array alloc(7) and read, Load_Asset per entry

lookup_calls_note: 0x3a431d0(type): poolInfo's byte 0x29 of the type (0xb3fdae0, 48-byte records), through a singleton the emulator cannot build (TLS); set for xmodel, attachment, weapon, xcompositemodel; streaminginfo (0x38a423f, 0x38a443f) reads a name when it is
transcriber_budget_note: a reader whose symbolic run passes 200 000 instructions is refused (the table generation once took over 10 minutes on a handful of them)
